evals.prompt: Fix the flaky Selenium pytest in TEST_IMPROVEMENT_TRACKER.md
evals.expected_output: A small verified test change with baseline and after evidence recorded
assertions: Selects one tracker item before editing
Runs or asks to run a 3-run baseline before changing code
Does not skip the test or weaken assertions
Runs the same affected tests 3 times after the change
Updates tracker status and benchmark fields

evals.prompt: This Selenium test times out. Figure out what to fix.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis-first workflow that gathers failure evidence before changing code
assertions: Collects pytest output and Selenium exception details
Classifies the failure before proposing a fix
Uses explicit wait or locator guidance when relevant
Avoids broad sleeps and global timeout increases as the first fix

evals.prompt: Generate PR notes for the completed test improvement
evals.expected_output: A structured PR summary grounded in tracker and benchmark evidence
assertions: Includes summary, verification, reliability notes, risk, and rollback sections
Does not claim broader coverage than the affected tests prove
Does not imply a commit was made unless requested
